From: Hyunwoo Kim <imv4bel@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 17:17:02 +0900
Subject: [PATCH] ksmbd: fix use-after-free of share_conf in compound request

smb2_get_ksmbd_tcon() reuses work->tcon in compound requests without
validating tcon->t_state. ksmbd_tree_conn_lookup() checks t_state ==
TREE_CONNECTED on the initial lookup path, but the compound reuse path
bypasses this check entirely.

If a prior command in the compound (SMB2_TREE_DISCONNECT) sets t_state
to TREE_DISCONNECTED and frees share_conf via ksmbd_share_config_put(),
subsequent commands dereference the freed share_conf through
work->tcon->share_conf.

Add the same t_state validation to the compound reuse path, consistent
with ksmbd_tree_conn_lookup().

Fixes: 5005bcb42191 ("ksmbd: validate session id and tree id in the compound request")
Signed-off-by: Hyunwoo Kim <imv4bel@gmail.com>
Acked-by: Namjae Jeon <linkinjeon@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Steve French <stfrench@microsoft.com>

diff --git a/fs/smb/server/smb2pdu.c b/fs/smb/server/smb2pdu.c
index 796cc2413817..0854f238b278 100644
--- a/fs/smb/server/smb2pdu.c
+++ b/fs/smb/server/smb2pdu.c
@@ -126,6 +126,8 @@ int smb2_get_ksmbd_tcon(struct ksmbd_work *work)
 			pr_err("The first operation in the compound does not have tcon\n");
 			return -EINVAL;
 		}
+		if (work->tcon->t_state != TREE_CONNECTED)
+			return -ENOENT;
 		if (tree_id != UINT_MAX && work->tcon->id != tree_id) {
 			pr_err("tree id(%u) is different with id(%u) in first operation\n",
 					tree_id, work->tcon->id);
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### 1. File Modified: `fs/smb/server/smb2pdu.c`

- **Function `smb2_get_ksmbd_tcon()`**:  
  Added a check for the state of the tree connection (`work->tcon->t_state`) in the compound request reuse path.  
  - **Before**: When a compound request reuses `work->tcon` from a previous command, no validation was performed on `tcon->t_state`.  
  - **After**: If `work->tcon->t_state` is not `TREE_CONNECTED`, the function returns `-ENOENT`, preventing access to a disconnected tree connection whose `share_conf` may have been freed.

### 2. Relationship Between Modifications

The single change closes a missing validation gap in the compound request handling logic. The initial lookup path (via `ksmbd_tree_conn_lookup()`) already validates that the tree connection is in the `TREE_CONNECTED` state. However, the compound reuse path bypassed this check, allowing use-after-free when a prior command (e.g., `SMB2_TREE_DISCONNECT`) disconnects the tree and frees associated resources. By adding the same `t_state` validation to the reuse path, the fix enforces consistent behavior across all code paths and eliminates the race condition.

Add the same t_state validation to the compound reuse path, consistent
with ksmbd_tree_conn_lookup().

Fixes: 5005bcb42191 ("ksmbd: validate session id and tree id in the compound request")
Signed-off-by: Hyunwoo Kim <imv4bel@gmail.com>
Acked-by: Namjae Jeon <linkinjeon@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Steve French <stfrench@microsoft.com>

Here is the root cause:
In compound requests, the function smb2_get_ksmbd_tcon() reuses work->tcon without checking if tcon->t_state is TREE_CONNECTED. If a prior command in the compound disconnects the tree (e.g., SMB2_TREE_DISCONNECT), subsequent commands access freed share_conf, leading to use-after-free.

Here is the patch:
  */
 int smb2_get_ksmbd_tcon(struct ksmbd_work *work)
 {
 	struct smb2_hdr *req_hdr = ksmbd_req_buf_next(work);
 	unsigned int cmd = le16_to_cpu(req_hdr->Command);
 	unsigned int tree_id;
 
 	if (cmd == SMB2_TREE_CONNECT_HE ||
 	    cmd ==  SMB2_CANCEL_HE ||
 	    cmd ==  SMB2_LOGOFF_HE) {
 		ksmbd_debug(SMB, "skip to check tree connect request\n");
 		return 0;
 	}
 
 	if (xa_empty(&work->sess->tree_conns)) {
 		ksmbd_debug(SMB, "NO tree connected\n");
 		return -ENOENT;
 	}
 
 	tree_id = le32_to_cpu(req_hdr->Id.SyncId.TreeId);
 
 	/*
 	 * If request is not the first in Compound request,
 	 * Just validate tree id in header with work->tcon->id.
 	 */
 	if (work->next_smb2_rcv_hdr_off) {
 		if (!work->tcon) {
 			pr_err("The first operation in the compound does not have tcon\n");
 			return -EINVAL;
 		}
+		if (work->tcon->t_state != TREE_CONNECTED)
+			return -ENOENT;
 		if (tree_id != UINT_MAX && work->tcon->id != tree_id) {
 			pr_err("tree id(%u) is different with id(%u) in first operation\n",
 					tree_id, work->tcon->id);
 			return -EINVAL;
 		}
 		return 1;
 	}
 
 	work->tcon = ksmbd_tree_conn_lookup(work->sess, tree_id);
 	if (!work->tcon) {
 		pr_err("Invalid tid %d\n", tree_id);
 		return -ENOENT;
 	}
 
 	return 1;
 }
